title: The Snow Day Inventors' Fair
skyStory: The moon has wandered into Aquarius, the sky's resident inventor, who keeps a workshop full of half-built gadgets and one suspiciously glowing kettle. Only three percent of the moon is showing, but every bit of it is wearing safety goggles. Aquarius wants weird ideas today. Not good ideas. Weird ones. Saturn, the old-school co-ruler, sighs and hands over a screwdriver.

reading: Saturday, and your inventor brain is fully caffeinated. You will look at an ordinary household object, maybe a colander or a clothes peg, and see three new uses for it. At least one of them is genuinely clever. At least one is completely unhinged. Build neither. Just sketch them.

[[The Magician]] is at your table today with every tool laid out, and the trick is choosing just one. Around 2 pm a fix will occur to you for something that has annoyed you for months, like a drawer that sticks. Rub the runners with a candle stub. Then brag about it, loudly, to the drawer.
joel.mission: Sketch three ridiculous inventions for one ordinary object and send the worst one to Nancy.
joel.omen: A clothes peg on the ground. It means a loose end is about to clip itself neatly into place.

reading: Aquarius brings a cold, bright wind off the water today, the kind that makes your eyes sparkle whether you like it or not. You will feel like rearranging something: a shelf, a playlist, a plan. Go ahead. Today you will see a better order for something everyone else thought was fine.

When Joel's terrible invention arrives, rate it out of ten with a full judge's comment. Be generous with points for audacity. The [[Queen of Swords]] sits on your shoulder today, sharp and fair and secretly delighted. Your verdict will become legend, and he will quote it for years.
nancy.mission: Rearrange one shelf or drawer into an order that only makes sense to you, and label it.
nancy.omen: Your own breath fogging into a shape. It means a fresh idea is ready to be spoken out loud.
nancy.stoneWhy: a calm surface for a busy mind

together.text: Hold the First Annual Ridiculous Invention Fair by text. Each of you submits one invention that solves a problem nobody has, with a name and a slogan. Saturn judges on practicality. Mars judges on explosions. Nobody wins, which Aquarius says is the whole point.

game.intro: Welcome to the Snow Day Inventors' Fair! Saturn judged the potato cannon and is still picking spuds out of his rings.
game.headline: SNOW DAY INVENTOR UNVEILS ___, SHOVELS EVERYWHERE FILE FORMAL COMPLAINT
